From the diagram, we see that $f(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=2$ and ${x}_{2,3}=-1\pm 3\text{i}.$ Additionally, we're given that the coefficient of the cubic term is $a=-2.$ Therefore, we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x) & =a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3}) \\  & =-2(x-2)(x-(-1+3\text{i}))(x-(-1-3\text{i}))\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}-2(x-2)(x-(-1+3\text{i}))(x-(-1-3\text{i})) & = \\ -2(x-2)({x}^{2}-x(-1-3\text{i})-x(-1+3\text{i})+(-1+3\text{i})(-1-3\text{i})) & = \\ -2(x-2)({x}^{2}+2x+10) & = \\ -2({x}^{3}+2{x}^{2}+10x-2{x}^{2}-4x-20) & = \\ -2({x}^{3}+6x-20) & = \\ -2{x}^{3}-12x+40 & .\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $f(x)=-2{x}^{3}-12x+40.$
